a.xlink:title: Receive data, blocking until a one-shot reception completes.
Start a DMA-based reception, completed on the IDLE line.
Reload the transfer count from handle->params.tx_size and start again.
Change the transfer length (element count) for the next transfer.
Disable the channel, stopping the transfer immediately.
Discard anything sitting in RDR and clear IDLE plus every RX error flag.
Get the peripheral instance for a slot (used by the interrupt handlers)
Enable the receiver and its DMA request line (CR1.RE, CR3.DMAR).
Disable the receiver and its DMA request line (CR1.RE, CR3.DMAR).
Clear every latched status flag (global/complete/half/error) for one channel.
Disable a channel and block until hardware confirms it is off.
Enable a channel, starting its transfer.
True if the channel is currently enabled.
